status: Frozen locally before new experimental outcomes; not an external registration
mechanism: All-layer gradient descent; no checkpoint deletion, clipping, early-stop selection or new weighting estimator
anchor_rule: Indices round(linspace(0,M-1,K+1)); each interior checkpoint uses its clipped Euclidean projection coefficient on the adjacent anchor parameter chord
lambda_grid: 10**linspace(-6,1,71); analysis only, no change to fitted weights

gates.remainder_improvement: At least 80% of dictionaries have primary piecewise certified Delta^2 <= 0.1 times global k=4 tangent Taylor Delta^2
gates.nonvacuity: At n=4096 at least 80% have the new population remainder below max_j R(f_j)-R(full convex oracle), using the generic derivative-based envelope B_mu+B_0+max||a_j||_1/sqrt(h); both this envelope and a sharper finite-population envelope are reported
gates.meaningful_training: For at least 80% of dictionaries the full convex oracle improves on initial-checkpoint risk by at least 10%; this excludes a nearly untrained zero predictor explanation
gates.novelty: A tighter sufficient-condition specialization alone does not pass the novelty gate. Record whether a substantive distinction from standard approximation plus aggregation theory remains. No claim of an exhaustive novelty search.

comparisons: All original candidates retained. Same-dictionary convex averaging, selection, last, all-equal and late-equal predictions evaluated. Previously completed fresh full-budget CV comparison retained in paper unchanged; this new finite-population geometry study is not a new full-budget CV comparison.
stop_rule: One protocol only. Report all 48 dictionaries, all three piece counts and all three n values. If novelty and nonvacuity do not both support the TEST positioning, stop this optimization loop and recommend against immediate TEST submission. No post-outcome scenario replacement.
